Welcome to the BC Public Service YouTube Channel.

If you’re considering a career in the BC Public Service, you’ll find videos that help you through the hiring process. You’ll also see videos of employees and projects nominated for  Premier’s Awards – presented annually to honour outstanding service to British Columbians – giving you a glimpse of public service professionalism, dedication and innovation across the province. If you’re a current employee, you can use the same videos on this channel to support organizational learning, continuous improvement, career growth and pride in the work you do for the citizens of British Columbia. Current employees can find additional videos on the @Work intranet. Please direct any inquiries to employeenews@gov.bc.ca.
